items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] WELL NOW TRIPP OBVIOUSLY TRAVELS A MORE BUSINESS KIND OF GUY.

ctx.x: He fired his cousin and put A.G. in there. And nobody blamed him. I don't think his cousin blamed. His cousin was spellbound by A.G.-------
WELL NOW TRIPP OBVIOUSLY TRAVELS A MORE BUSINESS KIND OF GUY. HE WAS MORE BUSINESS-MINDED KIND OF A GUY THEN SOMEONE LIKE COOK WOULD HAVE BEEN?
